details: The European Central Bank (ECB) held its key interest rates steady at its April 30 meeting. While officials are monitoring inflation and geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, which are contributing to higher energy costs and inflationary pressures, a potential rate hike in June is not ruled out if inflation risks persist.
title: ECB Maintains Rates, Cautious on Inflation and Geopolitical Risks

details: Morgan Stanley has launched new crypto trading services, reportedly offering competitive pricing compared to rivals. This development highlights the increasing integration of digital assets within traditional financial institutions, reflecting a growing institutional interest in the cryptocurrency space.
title: Morgan Stanley Enters Crypto Trading Market

details: The White House is aiming for the passage of the Clarity Act by July 4th, signaling a push for clearer regulatory frameworks for digital assets in the United States. Concurrently, Germany is considering ending its one-year crypto capital gains tax exemption, which would lead to stricter tax treatment for long-term cryptocurrency holders.
title: White House Pushes Crypto Clarity Act Amid Tax Talks

details: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index has moved to a score of 47, indicating a neutral sentiment across the market. This shift reflects a cautious phase among traders and investors as they reassess market direction amid ongoing economic uncertainties and digital asset volatility. Major cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin and Ethereum, have seen a pause in their recent rally.
title: Crypto Market Sentiment Turns Neutral Amid Volatility

details: Cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase has announced job cuts, attributing the decision to current market volatility and advancements in artificial intelligence. Separately, the decentralized finance (DeFi) sector has experienced an investor exodus following significant cyberattacks, including a recent $6.7 million exploit suffered by market maker TrustedVolumes.
title: Coinbase Cuts Staff as DeFi Sector Faces Hacks
